How to update images in this file ▾
To replace a background image or logo: upload the new file to Google Drive (or any public URL), then open this HTML in VS Code and find the relevant comment (e.g. <!-- BG-01 -->). Replace the data:image/png;base64,... string with url('https://your-new-url.png').

Easier option: send the new files to [email protected] or [email protected] and ask for an updated version of this file.

Logo

Use the correct logo version for each background. Never stretch, recolor, or modify the logo.

View all logo files on Google Drive

Full Wordmark

Dark BlueDefault — white or light backgrounds
Light BlueMid or dark blue backgrounds
WhiteDark, navy, or photo backgrounds

Icon / Symbol Only

Light Blue IconSocial profiles, favicon, app icon
Dark Blue IconWhite or light backgrounds
White IconDark or navy backgrounds

✓ Do

  • Use the provided logo files as-is
  • Maintain clear space (min. equal to the height of the E)
  • Use the white version on dark or image backgrounds
  • Use the dark blue version as the primary default

✗ Don't

  • Stretch, skew, or distort the logo
  • Change the logo colors
  • Place the logo on a busy or clashing background
  • Add drop shadows, outlines, or effects
